arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from POD reserve. My jobs: (1) keep boat computer honest: watch pod vs boat-model power ratio (eff_ratio) and heart rate vs pod power for pod drift; correct with pod_gain belief if pod drifts. (2) weed/drag: push_local drop within a leg, ratio drop in both directions -> clear_rudder. (3) course/radio messages -> set_race_distance + tell. (4) Check CP: if pod reserve reads empty but speed and HR hold, CP is low. Baseline ratio and HR/power after start settles (min 3-6). Few cues; no pieces unless a question needs one.
